title: Coastal Cottage | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Fun for Everyone! Beautiful Newly Built Two-Story Home with Private Pool - Views - Fronting Eastern Lake - Dock - Near Beach Access - South of 30A
description_expanded: Description: Coastal Cottage by Royal Destinations Address: 163 S Gulf Drive, Santa Rosa Beach, FL, 32459 Location: Seagrove Beach-Lake Front on Eastern Lake Details: Brand new, spacious home with 3,754 indoor square footage on a beautiful coastal lake that flows right to the gulf. So close to the beach that you can hear the surf from the porches while enjoying the gorgeous lake views. Coastal Cottage is located on Eastern Lake in Seagrove, south of Scenic Highway 30A between Seaside and Rosemary Beaches. 163 S. Gulf Drive is a quiet street that leads right to the beach, just 200 yards away. With 5 bedrooms, 4 full and 1 half baths, this home boasts custom amenities like high ceilings, shiplap walls, wood floors, custom cabinets, high-end finishes including custom tile baths and a bright, coastal chic decor throughout. The numerous outdoor spaces (two large porches, pool deck, large, fenced yard and dock) will have you wanting to wake up and enjoy breakfast beside the pool or lake before hitting the beach. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach: 0.1 Mile - *Private Heated Pool - Parking Spaces: 4 (including two car garage) - Dining Accommodations: Table for 10 and Bar Seating for 4 - Keurig and Nespresso Coffee Makers - Freestanding Ice Maker - Large Outdoor Decks (2) - Dock with Stand-Up Paddle Board! Direct Access to Eastern Lake - Smart TV in every room *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms / 1 Half Bath First Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub), Desk with Printer - Spacious Open Living Room, Dining Room, Gourmet Kitchen with Large Pantry, Half Bath, Outdoor Living - Stunning Views, Pool Deck Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed, Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub), Porch, Views - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bath (Shower) - Guest Bedroom 4: King Bed, Queen Murphy Bed, Private Bath (Shower) - Guest Bedroom 5: Bunk Room (Two Sets Twin/Twin Bunks with built -in storage) Amenities Included: - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Wagon - Outdoor Shower Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
